Lately not great. I’ve used this app for almost 5 years and it’s always been great. A month or so ago I noticed the transactions weren’t matching up to my bank correctly. I reconcile twice a week, so it should’ve been easy to find. I manually compared transactions to find a duplicate entry had been added for a past date (after I had previously reconciled). I fixed it and moved on.  This week I noticed the numbers don’t match again. I’ve reconciled all of October and can’t find the issue. I shouldn’t have to go back to September when I check it twice a week.  It’s becoming more frustrating than it is worth and I’m thinking about finding a new app.

The Maths are Wrong. I’ve been using this app for years to track my spending. In the last month there have been some major matching errors. For example, an income reads $549 HIGHER than what I actually put in there - the total doesn’t match the transactions. That’s in a line that gets zeroed out monthly, so it’s easy to see. This month my total spending  read almost $900 LESS than it should. I’ve spent hours going through bank records and the individual transactions match up, but the total remains incorrect. Time to move on to a new app.

Best Envelope Budgeting App. This app is fantastic! It is a convenient and uncomplicated envelope budgeting app that was exactly what I was looking for. I started as a free subscriber back in college and upgraded later. I love that they offer a fully functional “free forever” version, and I also think the paid version is very reasonably priced for a few added features and more complex budgets. 100% recommend this app to anyone looking to begin or continue envelope budgeting.

My favorite so far. We’ve been using Goodbudget for several years now, after trying multiple budgeting apps. It’s the best solution we’ve found to budget with an envelope system, while utilizing credit cards and online payments.
Envelopes LOST!. Updated the app and all my envelopes got deleted!

Originally worked, but now is busted. I’ve been using this app and product for years. At some point in the last 2-3 years they have destroyed the reconciliation process. They indicated the implemented a feature some users wanted that is causing this. It took my hours and hours to finally figure out what the heck was going on with a bank I was using… DUE to the fact that GB screwed up the normal process for reconciliation and downloading “cleared” transactions. My bank was screwing customers by hiding deposits and refunds in statements and downloads. With proper reconciliation, which I finally had to do MANUALLY over 8 months of data to figure out where the errors were being injected.

Never trust a bank, and never trust a broken reconciliation process. No longer a user…

Intuitive app but horrible delay in transactions. This app has been very helpful for me financially and is pretty easy to use once you figure out how to move money around. My only issue is that unlike apps such as YNAB, this app takes forever for transactions to show up on the app, when you look at the app you really just see the money you had 3 days ago. There needs to be an option for transactions to show up immediately instead of waiting for them to be completely cleared and then having to wait for plaid to update. Plaid also says they update automatically 1 to 4 times a day so I am confused as to why cleared transactions are taking over 24 hours to show up.

No iPad Support. This app is old and near unusable if like me you use an iPad in the Magic Keyboard.  This program looks like it may possibly have some cool features, but if they are too cumbersome to get to, do these features really matter?
Better for YNAB. I read the book, You Need A Budget, and then downloaded the app by the same org. Goodbudget is simpler and works better.

Finally Fixed!. The app being broken for 5 days almost had me go to another envelope app that’s actually FREE for me to use because I’m a coordinator for FPU.
This CAN NOT happen again!
You’ve GOT to test the app updates before you roll them out!
I’ve used this app for about 12-13 years now, and have always been happy with it up until this mess up.
For this, you loose one star!
Love this App. Can’t budget without it. It’s simple and easy to use. Best one out there.
App not syncing. App and desktop are not correctly syncing across multiple devices, please fix.
What is this?. Maddeningly complex app for no reason. I just want a tool that downloads transactions that I can categorize. This app ain’t it.

Keeps Spouses on the Same Page. I love this app and we have had it for several years, when it used to be called Easy Envelope Budget Assistant (EEBA). We did financial planning and budgeting classes early in our marriage and this app has allowed us to stay within our budget and communicating and recording our spending well. This has been such a support for our marriage and has saved us from many arguments!

dont know how this is a 5 star app. ashamed to say I wasted about an hour trying to make a budget. this application cant even do basic math.  seems the math got worse when i added more envelopes. youre better off putting your budget in a note, I would never pay a monthly sub for this.

Updates needed. I have multiple accounts that won’t sync with the app for some reason (they sync with my other apps no problem). That makes this a bit tedious but still pretty good. 
I also wish in the “annual budget” section that it would tell you when you have fully funded that budget for the year instead of only showing how much money you have left for the year. For instance, I don’t want to spend more than $2400 on gifts throughout the year but when I buy birthday gifts in Feb or March it only shows me the money left from what I’ve funded, but not how much more I need to fund. So it looks like I still need to add $2400 instead of the $2000 bc I spent $400.
Excellent for my needs!. Good budget perfectly fits the nuances of my situation. I’ve enjoyed the flexibility and features it offers!

No Bar Charts or Pie Charts 😕. Have loved this app and the charts but since the latest IOS update the charts don’t show up anymore.  I checked and there has not been an update to this app since a month ago. Please fix this!

best budget app!. i’ve used this app for almost two years. it’s the perfect app for me to use for simple budget projection. i use the free version and it has everything i need! it’s easy to navigate and simple to use. i love it. 

one suggestion— please fix the “due date” feature for “goal” envelopes, so that we can meet a goal for a single envelope more than once. sometimes i save the money for a particular category for a certain date, spend that money, and then want to save money for the same category again without having to delete the envelope history. but when doing this, it won’t tell me the amount to put in per pay period.
Better then anything I’ve used. Been using it for years. Keep it simple yall.
Ridiculously Complicated. It is more complicated than it needs to be I’m not going to be on for something that is forcing me to budget weekly monthly bi monthly tri yearly
Great Product. Very intuitive.  Easy to use.  Love the mobile app.

Life Changing!!. I have used Goodbudget for about 10 years and it has helped me completely turn my financial life around. I was bankrupt and and now I am the most financially stable person I know. There’s no better way to budget than envelope budgeting!
Needs improvement. Needs improvement on a number of features. One example is at on income you have to list twice the amount being deposited.
Buggy. I’m assuming there was an update to the app recently because now I cannot enter in my debt payments. Please fix.

Exceptional Usability Phenomenal Impact. Hard to explain just how amazing this app is. I by no means live paycheck to paycheck, but the methodology of enveloping has enhanced my finances and savings to a tremendous degree. Knowing what I should be spending (not what I can afford to spend) assured I save ~10% more a year than I would if I’d have been flying blind. The auto linkage with accounts they rolled out recently just continues to demonstrate the teams commitment to a wonderful life changing product
Scam. Paid for the subscription and my bank won’t even link. If you have Family Security don’t waste your time purchasing. The free version is also entirely wrong.
Loving this app!. Saved me hundreds if not thousands by tracking my spending and letting me have a honest look on how I spend my money
Not paying for everything. It would be better if they charged for the service not the envelope dumb

Good for iPhone not IPad. This app is definitely optimized for the phone, which is nice on the go for making sure you are keeping up to date with where your budget is at, but I prefer being able to sit down with the bigger iPad screen on payday or if I’m needing to do more than minor readjusting of the budget. It only is viewable in Portrait on the iPad, sorta, which doesn’t work for some of the iPad keyboards out there.

Very basic. Missing more stats and insights. I don’t mind at all putting things in manually. I really think there needs to be better stats and insights - “you are spending more on travel than last year” or “your dog walking expenses have gone up this quarter compared to last 2 quarters”. Something with AI. Or at least if I could manually compare category spending over time - track all dog envelope expenses over time to see how this changes over the last few years. Look at envelope for groceries to see if that’s been slowly rising or falling. It would be great if there’s a button - control for inflation - to see if there is just inflation growth in expenses or actually lifestyle inflation. A very very easy fix which I really want is the ability to look at the pie chart of all expenses over the last 12 months - not only calendar year 2024 vs 2025. But like the last 12 months from today. So many small adjustments I think would help analyze spending but it’s not even possible to view in the app.

Good principles, straightforward app. Good simple app - I find best to set things up on the website, and then this is a useful tool for knowing how much is in your envelopes when out and about and updating for expenses as they occur.

My assignment. I’m currently working on an assignment about a budgeting app, this app was super user friendly and it was really easy to set up, you can also have an accountwith your family members, though i wish they was less stuff about this because i wanted to write less stuff.
Terrific Budgeting App. Have been using for years and is feature rich. Cannot recommend highly enough!

Glitches. I don’t even know what’s going on anymore. I created all new envelopes (no rollovers), set them to fill at the first of the month, and somehow none of the math is mathing. I have one envelope filled with $800. I had a total of $105 set as a recurring payment to withdraw from this envelope. I have -$105 in this envelope now. Did it just not bother to fill? Anyway this is pretty useless as a way to keep track of money if it doesn’t even track things properly.

Outdated app with few feature updates. The premise of Goodbudget is great, but this is starting to feel like an old, outdated app with little to no feature updates and no user interface improvements. Definitely not worth the premium subscription cost they are asking for, and I have had nothing but chronic headaches even getting my paid subscription properly recognized in the app itself!

There are much better alternatives out there… save your money.

App Crashing and not saving envelopes. App keeps crashing when I try to input my debts with the “working to pay off” option and it isn’t saving my envelopes after pressing saved and I’ve just paid for Plus.

Worst ui ever built. Worst, most stupid, and damn complicated app. I've never seen something more annoying and more frustrating in my life. It's like they intentionally made it so complicated so no one can use their app, and they are so happy seeing people not able to use their app.
